learnerProfile.description: Nurtures curiosity and love of learning. Acquires skills to inquire and research independently.
Explores concepts across disciplines. Engages with local and global issues.
Uses critical and creative thinking to tackle complex problems and make ethical decisions.
Expresses ideas confidently in multiple modes and collaborates effectively.
Acts with integrity and honesty. Takes responsibility for actions and consequences.
Appreciates own and others cultures. Seeks and evaluates diverse perspectives.
Shows empathy, compassion and respect. Makes a positive difference to others.
Approaches uncertainty with courage and creativity. Explores new ideas and strategies.
Understands importance of intellectual, physical and emotional balance.
Thoughtfully considers learning and experiences to improve understanding and growth.

descriptions: Tell the truth, no matter what price you have to pay.
Your actions must always match with your beliefs and your words.
Do the right thing even when it is difficult.
Being thankful by words and by actions, no matter what the situation is.
Being fair and impartial with ourselves and with everyone around us no matter what the cost is.
Forgive everyone in personal matters and no longer feel angry and bitter towards them.
But in critical, collective/institutional matters, forgiveness may even be harmful.
Always be ready to admit small and big mistakes.
Never feel superior or even better than others.
Always be ready to help and support everyone in need.
Spending your time, energy, kind words, attention and money to help others.
